decision_cruda.rationale: Radio at 10:00 stops TJ-E569-08 (ventilation), which frees LH-03 (LH514). The CMMS is empty, so the radio and CMMS do not conflict. Per RESERVE-01, a reserve can only be activated with that freed loader, so there are no loans. Central has 4 trucks (about 90 t/h by my estimate) against 4 loaders (about 160 t/h), so it is truck-limited and a reserve there adds nothing. Norte has 3 trucks (about 66 t/h) but only LH-07 mucking (about 29 t/h), so it is loader-limited and a second loader fills the gap. RS-N548-03 is 18.4 g/t, which is about 0.59 oz/t, with 311 t of broken ore. LH514 at 160 m from the stockpile mucks 42*100/(100+0.15*60) = about 38.5 t/h. Timing: travel is about 0.72 h (Este to Norte via the surface road) plus 1.0 h activation, so loading starts about 11:45 and runs to 17:00, roughly 5.2 h. That is about 200 t, under the 311 t available, so about 118 oz. Together with LH-07 the Norte trucks run near capacity (about 67 t/h), so I add no further loaders. I subtract a few oz for haul lag and uncertainty, giving about 115 oz net. No development loader is moved, so there is no development cost. LH-10 sits in TALLER-564 with no CMMS work order, so I do not rely on it.
